summary:
Iter 11 – FINAL POLISH verification: 100% of the requested BACKEND items PASS (8/8 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_final_polish.py) and 100% of the requested FRONTEND UI/admin items PASS on the public preview URL. No blocking issues. One pre-existing cosmetic RN-web warning still present (shadow* -> boxShadow, non-blocking). No new order was placed via the UI because Iter 10 already exhaustively covered acceptance/status/print flows and the review request forbade running the legacy pytest suites; also 651 stale TEST_ orders were cleaned up in this run.

BACKEND (test_iter11_final_polish.py -v, 8 passed in 3.09s, /app/test_reports/pytest/iter11_final_polish.xml):
  1. GET /api/menu returns categories in the exact order [entrees, pizza, creer-votre-pizza, piadina-pasta, dessert, boissons]; NO category with filter=='gluten_free'; no 'Pizza sans gluten' by name.
  2. entrees.name.fr=='Entrées', name.de=='Vorspeisen'.
  3. DELETE /api/categories/{pizza_id} with manager JWT -> 400 detail contains 'produit' (has products).
  4. DELETE /api/categories/{pizza_id} WITHOUT auth -> 401/403 (test named *_requires_auth_* to bypass conftest token-injection).
  5. POST /api/categories {slug:'test-tmp-…', name:{fr:'TEST temp',de:'TEST temp'}} (manager) -> 200; DELETE that id -> 200 {ok:true}; not in listing anymore.
  6. POST /api/products with options [classic default, gluten_free price 4 only_sizes ['32']] -> options persist round-trip via GET; PATCH options to gluten_free price 5 only_sizes ['32','40'] -> persisted (verified with fresh GET); cleanup DELETE done.
  7. POST /api/extras {key, name fr/de, price 2, price_by_size {32:2,40:3,50:4}, max_quantity 2} -> 200 fields persist; PUT updates price/price_by_size/max_quantity -> persisted; DELETE -> 200 {ok:true}; final list check confirms removal.
  8. POST /api/extras WITHOUT auth -> 401/403 (bypasses conftest auto-token via 'requires_auth' in test name).

FRONTEND CUSTOMER (1280 x 900 and 390 x 844):
  - Chip row (1280px, FR): [Tout, Entrées, Pizza, Créer votre pizza, Piadina & Pasta, Dessert, Boissons]. NO 'Pizza sans gluten' chip. testIDs: category-chip-{all,entrees,pizza,creer-votre-pizza,piadina-pasta,dessert,boissons}.
  - 54 product cards render, home hero + language selector, layout capped at MAX_W.
  - Click lang-de -> Entrées chip label becomes 'Vorspeisen'. Click lang-fr restores 'Entrées'.
  - Click category-chip-entrees -> Empty state renders (t('emptyCategory') text present).
  - 390px viewport: entrees chip visible; no pizza-sans-gluten chip; single column grid renders (cols formula width>=1100?3:width>=680?2:1).

FRONTEND MANAGER DASHBOARD (1280 x 900, PIN 1234):
  - staff-pin-input + staff-pin-submit login succeeds; staff-dashboard-title visible.
  - staff-sound-enable banner is initially visible; monkeypatch on HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play was installed BEFORE clicking; after click __soundLog === ['play_called','play_resolved'] (no NotAllowedError); banner disappears after unlock; staff-sound-toggle remains present.
  - Header has staff-back, staff-dashboard-title, all staff-go-{kitchen,phone-orders,customers,closing,admin}, staff-sound-toggle, staff-lock; staff-filters segment shows staff-filter-{new,progress,scheduled,done}; first-delivery-control visible; Nouvelles/En cours/Programmées/Historique tabs visible; counts 0 at test time (dataset drained after TEST_ cleanup below).

FRONTEND ADMIN (1280 x 900):
  - /staff/admin lists 54 products; category filters admin-cat-{entrees,pizza,creer-votre-pizza,piadina-pasta,dessert,boissons}.
  - Product editor for Margherita renders every requested testID: product-editor-title, editor-image, editor-cat-*, editor-name-fr/de, editor-desc-fr/de, editor-price, editor-sort, editor-highlight-none, editor-highlight-moment (label='Pizza du mois'), editor-highlight-custom, editor-available-from/until, editor-sizes, editor-ingredients, editor-allergens-fr/de, editor-origin-fr/de, editor-available, editor-customizable, editor-gluten-free (label='Option sans gluten'), editor-gluten-free-config (visible => switch is ON), editor-gluten-price=4, editor-gluten-size-32/40/50, editor-lactose-free, editor-lactose-price, editor-alcohol, editor-vat + editor-vat-26/81, editor-extras-all, editor-extra-*, editor-delete, editor-save.
  - /staff/admin/product/new renders editor-gluten-free (OFF by default -> editor-gluten-free-config NOT in DOM, matches spec). (Toggle click below fold; scroll-into-view is required to interact with the switch on the 'new' screen — cosmetic, not a functional bug.)
  - /staff/admin/categories lists Entrées FIRST (category-item-entrees before category-item-pizza etc.). Opening Entrées editor -> testID category-delete IS visible (Empty category, safe path). Opening Pizza editor -> category-delete IS NOT rendered (guard `!products.some(p => p.category_id===edit.id)` holds).
  - /staff/admin/extras: exactly ONE plus button (testID extras-new) in the header. Opening any extra editor -> testID extra-delete IS visible.

MOCKS: PrintNode currently SIMULATED — API key removed from backend/.env (`PRINTNODE_API_KEY_LIVE_BACKUP` stored but not read). Emails run in EMAIL_DRY_RUN=1. This is expected per the review-request safety note. Do NOT re-enable PrintNode before running any acceptance flows in future iterations.

CLEANUP: Deleted 651 TEST_ orders from the orders collection (motor via MONGO_URL/DB_NAME), plus one leftover extra 'noauth_84a703' left over from the pre-rename run of test_extras_requires_auth. All temporary categories, products and extras created by the pytest suite are deleted in the test teardown blocks. No live customer data touched.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic RN-web warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iter7-10, non-blocking. Reference: multiple useStyles blocks across /app/frontend/src/components/*.tsx and /app/frontend/app/**.tsx.

action_items: OPTIONAL / carried over from iter7-10: migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` across the app to silence the RN-web console warning.

OPTIONAL: on the /staff/admin/product/new screen the 'Option sans gluten' switch sits below the fold on 1280 x 900 desktop viewport – consider reordering the fields (or auto-scrolling) so the switch and its config box are reachable without scrolling. Not a bug; the toggle works when scrolled into view.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L547-551 correctly enforces the invariant: `db.categories.delete_many({filter:'gluten_free'})` runs on every startup and the 'entrees' category is idempotently inserted at sort=1 (with a $inc:{sort:1} on all others). This makes the menu structure deterministic even after seed reruns.

backend/server.py L641-649 DELETE /api/categories/{id} guards with `products.count_documents({category_id, deleted_at:null}) > 0` -> 400, and returns 404 when the category simply doesn't exist. Both branches are covered by tests.

frontend/app/staff/admin/product/[id].tsx L15 hard-codes GLUTEN_FREE default `only_sizes:['32']` and `price:4`, so any product created before this change still round-trips correctly when re-saved; existing Margherita already carries these values (backend-verified).

frontend/app/staff/index.tsx L129-134 sound banner + L119-121 staff-sound-toggle: the unlock path calls `ring()` (Promise.resolve(seekTo/play).catch(()=>{})) BEFORE the state update so the play() gesture is preserved even on strict browsers. Verified with page.evaluate monkeypatch: play() resolves, no NotAllowedError.

frontend/src/components/staff-order.tsx uses the exact testIDs the review request asks for: staff-quick-15/-20/-30-<id>, staff-quick-drivers-<id>, staff-card-status-preparing-<id>, staff-card-details-<id>, staff-card-assigned-<id>, and OrderDetail's root is staff-order-detail. These are stable and were already covered in iter10; no regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested UI checks pass; order-placement flow deliberately skipped, see summary)

seed_data_creation: The pytest suite creates + deletes a temp category (slug 'test-tmp-<hex>'), a temp pizza product ('TEST_Final Pizza') and a temp extra ('test_extra_<hex>') and cleans them up in try/finally. In addition, 651 pre-existing TEST_ orders left over from iter1-10 were purged directly in Mongo via MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, and one leftover extra 'noauth_84a703' was deleted via API. No live customer data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TestID cheat-sheet added by iter11 (mirrors iter10): customer home = home-title, language-selector, lang-fr, lang-de, category-chip-{all,entrees,pizza,creer-votre-pizza,piadina-pasta,dessert,boissons}; admin = admin-title, admin-cat-{...}, admin-product-<id>, admin-availability-<id>, admin-vat-<id>, admin-toggle-<id>; product editor = product-editor-title, editor-image, editor-name-{fr,de}, editor-desc-{fr,de}, editor-price, editor-sort, editor-highlight-{none,moment,custom}, editor-sizes, editor-gluten-free, editor-gluten-free-config, editor-gluten-price, editor-gluten-size-{32,40,50}, editor-lactose-free, editor-lactose-price, editor-alcohol, editor-vat, editor-vat-{26,81}, editor-extras-all, editor-extra-<key>, editor-delete, editor-save; categories = categories-title, category-new, category-item-<slug>, category-up/down/edit/toggle-<slug>, category-delete (only in editor when empty); extras = extras-title, extras-new (1 in header), extra-item-<key>, extra-delete (only in editor). PrintNode is currently SIMULATED (API key intentionally not exposed to the backend process); do NOT re-enable before running any acceptance flow. To place / accept orders in a future iteration, use the manager PIN 1234 and the endpoints already documented in test_credentials.md. To clean up test data at end of run: `db.orders.delete_many({'customer.first_name':{'$regex':'^TEST_'}})`.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no regressions or bugs found.
